content.title: Moderna and Merck pop on cancer vaccine, Lucid-Rockwell partnership
content.description:
Market Domination Host Josh Lipton and Yahoo Finance Senior Reporter Brooke DiPalma track several of the day's top trending stock tickers, including Travelers Companies' (TRV) fourth quarter earnings results, Moderna (MRNA) and Merck (MRK) shares popping on skin cancer vaccine trial results, and Lucid (LCID) surging on its partnership with Rockwell Automation powering its EV facility in Saudi Arabia.

To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out more Market Domination.

content.title: Travelers’s (NYSE:TRV) Q4 CY2025 Earnings Results: Revenue In Line With Expectations
content.summary: Property and casualty insurer Travelers (NYSE:TRV) met Wall Streets revenue expectations in Q4 CY2025, with sales up 3.1% year on year to $12.43 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $11.13 per share was 26.8% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
